Agent.comment: The ur-agent witness carried with a run projection so monovocal voicing can be validated in the same projection batch.

agt:hasVoice.source: the single monovocal voice for the WS-7 run path

agt:voicing.source: agt:Monovocal for the WS-7 flavor-a run path

Run.comment: §WS1 RELEVEL - one execution within a session (was the run-grain agt:Session). Carries agt:realizedBy -> the wf:Run anchor and the inference binding actually used. Field names match the generic-record builder (agt:provider/agt:model); the serializer face uses agt:inferenceProvider/Model.

agt:realizedBy.source: inverse reading of wf:Run wf:boundToAgent agt:Run

agt:supersedesLegacyRunSession.source: §WS1 migration bridge to the pre-relevel run-grain agt:Session

Session.comment: §WS1 RELEVEL - the prompt-bearing EPISODE keyed on the libsql session id; pins one model + one prompt snapshot; spans its runs (NO realizedBy).

agt:model.source: the inference model the session pins

Tool.comment: A tool referenced by a node-grain run turn.

Turn.comment: Node-grain agt:Turn for one workflow node invocation. Message-grain chat turns remain on the older chat session path.

agt:inRun.source: §WS1 RELEVEL - the agt:Run this turn nests under (projection.ts:786)

agt:realizedBy.source: inverse reading of wf:AgentRun wf:boundToAgent agt:Turn

agt:turnGrain.source: node for workflow run turns; message is reserved for chat/message-grain turns

Voice.comment: The single elided monovocal voice required to satisfy agt:I3 cardinality while keeping materialized subjects in URN space.

WorkflowAgentRunAnchor.comment: A projection-local anchor that carries the wf:AgentRun type inside projection:session so agt:Turn agt:realizedBy can be SHACL-validated without cross-graph lookups.

WorkflowRunAnchor.comment: A projection-local anchor that carries the wf:Run type inside projection:session so agt:Session agt:realizedBy can be SHACL-validated without cross-graph lookups.

comment: WS-7 run-session projection vocabulary. It is the direct-on-store projection companion to wf-agent-binding: a generic simple-projection pack with write_target projection:session. It validates run-grain agt:Session and node-grain agt:Turn subjects, plus the monovocal Agent/Voice witness needed by the agt contract.
description: Projection contract for WS-7 run-grain agent sessions and node-grain turns.
